map.基准寿命 matBaseLife 按材料取（聚合物120/橡胶60/复合材料18: Base life matBaseLife by material (polymer 120 / rubber 60 / composite 180 / coating 48 / lubricant 24 months, at 25 C, 50% RH, pH 7); temperature factor Q10 = 2 (every 10 C rise halves life), humidity factor above 70% accelerates and below 40% slows, pH factor most active at 6 to 8, UV factor decreases with stronger irradiation; estLife = base times each factor, degradation rate = 100 / estLife.
map.聚合物、工况 25℃/60%RH/pH7/无紫外：各因子均 1，estLife=: Polymer, condition 25 C / 60% RH / pH 7 / no UV: all factors 1, estLife = 120 months (excellent, degradation 0.83% / month). Change to rubber, 40 C / 80% RH / pH 5 / UV 200: temperature factor 0.354, humidity 0.885, pH 1.117, UV 0.880, estLife about 18.4 months (poor, frequent replacement needed).
map.为什么温度每升 10℃ 寿命减半？: Why does life halve every 10 C rise?
map.高分子降解多属热活化反应，Q10≈2 是经验规律；高温加速分子链断裂与微生物活性: Polymer degradation is mostly a thermally activated reaction, Q10 about 2 is an empirical rule; high temperature accelerates molecular chain breakage and microbial activity, but the material glass transition temperature and upper limit must also be considered.
map.pH 中性区为什么反而更活跃？: Why is the neutral pH range more active?
map.多数微生物在 pH 6~8 最适生长，故该区间生物降解因子取 1（不减缓）；偏酸: Most microbes grow best at pH 6 to 8, so this range has a biodegradation factor of 1 (no slowing); acidic or alkaline deviation inhibits it, raising the factor (longer life), but chemical corrosion may be counted separately.
map.关于「生物稳定寿命评估」: About the Biostability Life Assessment tool
